Q. Q. 4 اِضْمَحَلَّ , (S, O, K,) mentioned in the K in a separate art., its author, and some others, holding the م to be radical, but most of the leading authorities on inflection hold it, with J [and Sgh and Fei], to be augmentative; (TA;) and اِمْضَحَلَّ, (S, O, Msb, K,) of the dial. of the Kilá- bees, mentioned by AZ, formed by transposition of the م; (S, O, TA;) and اِمْضَحَنَّ, (K,) formed by substitution, mentioned by Yaakoob; (TA;) It (a thing, S, O) went away; (S, O, Msb, K;) and came to nought. (Msb.) ―
-b2- And said of clouds (سَحَاب), They became removed, or cleared off. (S, O, Msb, K.) ―
-b3- And i. q. اِنْحَلَّ [It became untied, or undone, &c.]. (K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
